3628c2ad2c1879101f61bdf6-29a104402ea9c39.title: Jim Lauderdale
3628c2ad2c1879101f61bdf6-29a104402ea9c39.reason: A strong Americana/bluegrass songwriter in a fully seated small-room matinee; worth the Novato trip.

fda0abbba8acc9740b5c9bd9-f20c82c8fe6f406.title: Lonesome Ace Stringband duo (John Showman & Chris Coole)
fda0abbba8acc9740b5c9bd9-f20c82c8fe6f406.reason: Showman & Coole pair fiddle and clawhammer banjo across old-time, bluegrass and folk, including Dock Boggs and John Hartford repertoire. A particularly close musical fit, with time to plan the Monterey trip.

ac68148e4f9394717d146b3b-fc914dbae7ce569.title: Caleb & Reeb and the Cali Cutups
ac68148e4f9394717d146b3b-fc914dbae7ce569.reason: Traditional country and bluegrass harmonies with the Cali Cutups; promising destination show for roots music rather than a generic touring recommendation.

2992eee1743cf894ce5ce09e-09677877ccb09d3.title: THE CROOKED JADES--Sunday, December 6
2992eee1743cf894ce5ce09e-09677877ccb09d3.reason: Experimental old-time instrumentation and repertoire in an intimate Berkeley house-concert setting are an unusually close fit.

f0f4126aa456af5beb7ab1fc-d7530d487a3db56.title: KENDL WINTER, solo -- SATURDAY, DECEMBER 12
f0f4126aa456af5beb7ab1fc-d7530d487a3db56.reason: A solo acoustic artist at Fifth Street Farms merits a close listen; intimate roots venue and banjo-oriented adjacency fit the radar.
